experiment.name: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume_earlystop
experiment.description: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume (step 4) with early stopping added (patience on val loss) and MAX_EPOCHS raised from 20 to 100 -- now that early stopping makes a high ceiling safe, training runs until val loss genuinely stops improving instead of being cut off at a hand-picked fixed epoch count. Flat LR=6e-4 unchanged (no schedule) -- the cosine-schedule experiment already showed converging faster/harder hurts directional accuracy/coherence, so this isolates 'run until done' from 'push harder'.

loss_weights.note: unweighted -- single RevIN-normalized MSE over the 4 OHLC channels
